book.name: KOLOSI
book.title: KOLOSI Pol so mamey, sios Kolosi mon ma lwak se ma mey kow ha hok non

content: Liaup-uwr om, homkwe hmo mey-uwrsa puraw mokwe yaprue nonaw, seyr luw-luw-aw kwa hiy-wayr. Payhokuaw, hom seyn, Liaup-uwr non, hiykwe nonkumey mon lwak.
Lanok-anok ok
Homkwe God se kokwe senkinaw-aw mesopok e, seyr enekwei hom mesopok ankin, homkwe iray-iray non kwa nak-wak, seyr God se kwa nak-me-ihey.

Enekwei hom God se mesopok ankin, homkwe hreme God se kwa hiy-mesopok. Sa hiykwe hreme yerki yaprue, hrom ouon-aw-ok Krais se ma lohruw-a ke mesor ey se ka kampi kow. Payhokuaw, ha kalabus mon ma lwak ohokwe mo sehe lwak.
Homkwe God se senkin mesopok e, ha ok mesor ankin, hakwe kumay-ar ka nuw-mesor hrahra ha, God hiykiaw ma nan senkin.

Homkwe hmo weynpaweyn, uwrsa Krais se ma nan kiykiy-ay lopa me ma mesair kow mokwe, mawkhow ihey-ar non kwa nak-mesair kow. Enekwei hmo nan kiykiy-ay yor me me-sor kow ey hom lousne ankin, homkwe enekwei senkin somokwe mey yaprue kwa meio.
Enekwei enekwei hno ok, uwrsa me nion ma non-ohruw-a mokwe yaprue ka lwoun, seyr wonor ka lwak. Seyr hunkwe uwrsa lowpwarowp mo mesopok me ma-sahre onuayk me yerki hokwe nonkway kwa nuw-wak popriy.
Me-ihey ok pariawey
Tikikus, hromo wayh ihey-ar, seyr hiymon kraiay wayr uwr ipey-ar, seyr Hakamay so mey ke ma non-wawwaw meio hiykwe, ha penkin lwak e, hme ya me-nonkway kow a.
Hakwe hyekwe hmo owh mon sehe me-ha, sa hiy, hrom lowpwarowp erey ma lwak hom penkin lwak e, seme hme mesor kow ankin, hiykwe hme kar liy mon ey.
Hye nion kokwe Onesimus hiy non-e. Hiykwe hromo wayh ihey-ar, seyr mey meio kraipakrai uwr, seyr hmo sios arian ko. Hohkwe weynpaweyn erey ma lousne omokwe, hme liy mesor kow.

Aristarkus, uwr hane nion kalabus mon ma non-wak hiykwe hme me-ihey ok me-ha, Mak, Barnabas so uwr eynay o. (Homkwe Mak hiy hmo owh mon le ankin, hye me-huonok huon ey so lanok-anok-ok mokwe po lonok.)
Seyr Jisas, Justus-ok ma mowie hiykwe seyr hme me-ihey ha. Juda-uwr ma nan kiykiy-ay, hane nion God so Wayr-hre-yier so mey me ma meio kow mokwe mo homkwaw pruompri-ar. Homkwe hane kraiar po hiy-mon.

Epafras hiykwe seyr hme me-ihey ha. Hiykwe hmo sios arian ko, seyr Krais Jisas so mey-uwr. Hiykwe enekwei enekwei hyo uron lowpwarowp non kokwe hme God se hiy-mesopok, God hiy hme mon orok kraipakrai e, seyr hom God so uron ko so meyki-aw nuw-ey e, kristen-ar mnow-mnow-aw ma lwak, seyr God se uron lowpwarowp non ma nan kiykiy-ay me hieyn.
Hakiaw kokwe hme senkin mekow, hiykwe hme o, Laodisia me o, Hierapolis me o, hme lowpwarowp hiymon ey mokwe, mey kraiar po meio.
Hromo wayh ihey-ar Luk, dokta o, Demas o, hohkwe hme me-ihey ha.
Hromo me-ihey ok mokwe, hromo wayh-om Laodisia ko o, Nimfa o, sios hoko a mon ma hokruw o, seme kwa mekow ha.
Mamey okukwe hom lira mesor lowpway ankin, homkwe sios Laodisia ko mon kwa ma-lira mesor. Seyr liy-liy-aw, homkwe mamey, ha wayh-om Laodisia ko me ma mey kow ha ke kwa ma-lira mesor.
Seyr Arkipus se kwa mekow, “Mey, Hakamay hiy hne ma kow kokwe, hunkwe kwa meio lowpway.”
Me-ihey ok okukwe hano iha arian non kiy-mey: “Pol hakwe hme me-ihey ha.” Homkwe ha kalabus-a mon ma lwak ohokwe peie lorionay o. God so maym hokwe hme nion ka non-wak.
